title: ipomoea retropilosa
intro: Ipomoea retropilosa, commonly known as the Australian moonflower or moon vine, is a perennial climber native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used in Australian medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea retropilosa include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may help to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Ipomoea retropilosa include iridoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
